description: This source file defines an interface for a builder that creates instances of SearchResult, supporting method chaining for setting pagination parameters and adding or removing JSON items.

classes.name: SearchResultBuilder
classes.description: A mutable builder with a fluent API for a SearchResult, allowing to set pagination info and modify search results.

methods.name: nextPageOffset
methods.description: Sets the offset for the next page of results, or indicates no further page.

methods.name: cursor
methods.description: Sets the cursor for the next page, or null if none.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds one or more JsonValue items to the search results.

methods.name: addAll
methods.description: Adds all provided JsonValue items to the results.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a specified JsonValue item from the results.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Creates an immutable SearchResult object with the current accumulated items and pagination info.
